keyPoints.en: Informal letter: sender's address and date top right; no recipient's address; friendly salutation (Ayahanda, Sahabatku).
keyPoints.bm: Surat tidak rasmi: alamat pengirim dan tarikh di kanan atas; tiada alamat penerima; panggilan mesra (Ayahanda, Sahabatku).

keyPoints.en: Opening greeting → content → closing with greetings and name.
keyPoints.bm: Pembuka kata → isi → penutup dengan kiriman salam dan nama.

keyPoints.en: Formal letter: sender's address, recipient's address, date, "Tuan,", bold title (Aduan/Permohonan/Cadangan), numbered points.
keyPoints.bm: Surat rasmi: alamat pengirim, alamat penerima, tarikh, "Tuan,", tajuk tebal (Aduan/Permohonan/Cadangan), isi bernombor.

keyPoints.en: End with "Sekian, terima kasih.", "Yang benar,", signature and full name.
keyPoints.bm: Akhiri dengan "Sekian, terima kasih.", "Yang benar,", tandatangan dan nama penuh.

tip.en: Ask: who is the reader? That decides formal or informal.
tip.bm: Tanya: siapakah pembaca? Itu menentukan rasmi atau tidak rasmi.

keyPoints.en: Essay: pendahuluan, isi (isi + huraian + contoh), penutup.
keyPoints.bm: Karangan: pendahuluan, isi (isi + huraian + contoh), penutup.

keyPoints.en: Narrative: watak, latar, plot (permulaan, perkembangan, klimaks, peleraian); open with action or dialogue.
keyPoints.bm: Naratif: watak, latar, plot (permulaan, perkembangan, klimaks, peleraian); mulakan dengan aksi atau dialog.
